scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Purchase/Construct New Fishing Craft less than 26 feet for Fishing in Inland Waters of Goa
other_conditions: Applicant must be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession
Fishing canoe must be registered with the Department of Captain of Ports, Government of Goa
Benefits can be availed only once every 7 years against replacement of the existing canoe
benefits_summary: 50% subsidy up to ₹30,000 for general category and 60% subsidy up to ₹36,000 for SC/ST/Women on a unit cost of ₹60,000 (excluding GST), available once every 7 years
documents_required: Prescribed format of the application form (obtained by paying ₹50)
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
